title: Amadeus

conquest.title: Combo Slash
conquest.description: Amadeus casts enemies in the target area upward followed by three powerful slashes, each dealing Attack*160%/176%/192%/208%/224% damage.

conquest.title: Arcane Swordship
conquest.description: Amadeus releases a burst of arcane energy with each sword slash, dealing Attack*15%/17%/19%/21%/23% damage to frontal foes.

conquest.title: Onslaught
conquest.description: Amadeus is a master at pressing his advantage, increasing Attack by 16%/24%/32%/40%/48% when Health is above 50%.

expedition.title: Battle Ready
expedition.description: Young ranger Amadeus excels in boosting morale, increasing the total Squads' Lethality by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.title: Way of the Blade
expedition.description: Amadeus imparts the secrets of swordsmanship, increasing the total Squads' Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.title: Unrighteous Strike
expedition.description: Amadeus' unique swordplay has a 8%/16%/24%/32%/40% chance of increasing damage dealt by 50% for all squads.

talent.title: Born Leader
talent.description: Amadeus inspires at all times even when absent, boosting Lethality and Health for all deployed soldiers by 3%/6%/9%/12% / 15%.

skills.title: Double Parry

story: Amadeus is an incredible swordsman in both speed and power. His twin swords are fast enough, some say, to split a river in two. That seems unbelievable until you witness him for yourself.

On the outside, Amadeus is quiet. Rough. But underneath his dark exterior lies a heart of gold. Perhaps because Amadeus' adoptive father understood that about him so well that he was allowed Amadeus to accom Pany him on his outlaw adventures. While Amadeus' advice may be unreliable, his swordsmanship never let the League down.

Amadeus' strengths would soon be put to the test in unfamiliar territory: town. He is stopped immediately by Jabel, a c Avalrywoman shocked he would enter so openly with a bounty on his head. And also that such a bounty could lie on the head of one so young.
But Amadeus was determined. Duty was calling. The air became thick with the possibility of a fight... until someone finally intervened. A great shield between the two defused the tension at last.

The group that Amadeus had been part of through his father is the "Unjust League", widely condemned as a criminal organization. Its leader, "Robin Hood", is regarded as an outlaw, particularly by the nobility for his fondness for robbing the wealthy. That is what the townsfolk found so intriguing about Amadeus' openness. There was a certain courage and honesty on the part of the young man.

One might have expected such a notorious outlaw would be shunned. Yet the town cautiously welcomed him as he went about his day. For his part, Amadeus made sure any friendly service was met with equally friendly and prompt payment.
What a surprise! Amadeus found himself wondering: Could this town be truly as wise and fair as they say? Perhaps there is an oasis to be carved out in this lawless world?

"What do you think? If she's always coming up with reasons to bother you? If she's always finding excuses to watch you? I say it's very interesting. I say it's the hallmarks of a shy girl." But Quinn would always say that, the self-proclaimed warrior-poet and expert on love.

Amadeus looked back at Quinn blankly. Quinn quickly added: "Think about it: a c Avalrywoman of principle. An outlaw with a heart of gold? Well? You two have promise." Meanwhile, Seth was furiously scribbling the conversation down in one of his diaries.
Quinn's table conversation was interrupted by a flying pitcher.
"I think we've all drunk enough for one evening, eh? Time for some fun."
